name: cloudflare_list_zones
description: List the zones (domains) the token can access. Returns an array of {id, name, status, ...}; the zone `id` is the `zone_id` every DNS record tool needs. Optional `name` to filter to an exact domain (e.g. 'example.com') and `per_page` (default 50, max 50 effective here). Use this first to resolve a domain name to its zone id.

name.description: Exact domain name to filter zones by, e.g. 'example.com'. Omit to list all accessible zones.
